author: Barrie Linch
text: That's a very high percentage of sensors coming off. I have been using Libre continuously for over 10 years and have never had one fall off. Everybody's skin is different, of course, but I wonder if some training from your diabetes team or nurse might assist in helping you attach the sensors so that they don't fall off.

author: Eileen Campbell
text: Skintac is the answer to loss prevention. Apply it to the site after the alcohol dries. I don't ever have one fall off and I've banged them on a doorjamb and scraped it with a bra strap and they stay put .
